title: Mercy restores the gratitude you ignored
summary: Mercy is first noticed when ingratitude is finally confessed. Keep gratitude tender and truthful.
lifeApplication: When the heart starts treating gift as ordinary, pause, touch the chest, and receive one mercy aloud today.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy is first noticed when ingratitude is finally confessed.
source.lifeApplication: Before complaining, name one mercy you have already been living on.

evidence.coreClaim: Mercy is first noticed when ingratitude is finally confessed.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: honest gratitude becomes the doorway to mercy and Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the heart starts treating gift as ordinary, pause, touch the chest, and receive one mercy aloud today.
